decision: L0001 exact member ranges must not be requested. The preregistered command-image bridge is not sufficiently discriminative to interpret natural missing positions.
preservedFailures: The original Python compact ledger overwrote per-trial slot arrays with scalar counts; amendment 03 and v0.2 preserve and correct it.
Python and JavaScript independently recover one singleton deletion each but on different trials, and agree on only 9 of 128 called slots.
The preregistered duplicate-only and affine-drift cases were not run because the primary deletion gate had already become logically impossible. They are unadjudicated, not successful.
